recordings.question_text: What should I do when caterpillars eat inside my young corn?

recordings.answer_text: Early-morning gasping often signals low oxygen in pond water. Avoid overfeeding, remove uneaten feed, and let fresh clean water trickle gently into the pond.
recordings.question_text: Why do pond fish come to the surface gasping early in the morning?

recordings.answer_text: Dry grains on raised mats or clean tarpaulins—never bare wet soil. Store only when kernels snap cleanly under your tooth, in sealed bags off the floor.
recordings.local_phrase_gloss: Mano Prototype Script (Consented Team Audio Demo)
recordings.question_text: How do I stop my harvested rice and corn from molding in storage?

recordings.answer_text: Keep the poultry coop dry, block cold wind with woven mats or tarpaulin, use dry wood shavings on the floor, and wash water drinkers every morning.
recordings.local_phrase_gloss: Mano Prototype Script (Consented Team Audio Demo — Fallback speech preview enabled until studio WAV upload)
recordings.question_text: How do I keep young chicks warm and healthy during rainy nights?

recordings.answer_text: Mix dry grass, kitchen peelings, and animal droppings into a shaded compost pile, turn it every two weeks, and add dark compost to planting beds before rain.
recordings.local_phrase_gloss: Bassa Prototype Script (Pending native speaker re-recording check)
recordings.question_text: How can I make poor sandy soil better without buying costly fertilizer?

recordings.answer_text: Check if rainwater is standing around the cassava mound. Open a small drainage trench so roots do not rot, and inspect under young leaves for small whiteflies.
recordings.local_phrase_gloss: Bassa Prototype Script (Consented Team Audio Demo — Fallback speech preview enabled until studio WAV upload)
